mapper.sql: SELECT a.approval_id,a.approval_no,a.approval_type,a.business_type,a.business_id, COALESCE(o.opportunity_name, CONCAT(a.business_type,' #',a.business_id)) business_name, a.requester_id,req.employee_name requester_name,a.approver_id,apv.employee_name approver_name, a.title,a.request_payload,a.status,a.requested_at,a.processed_at,a.canceled_at,a.created_at,a.updated_at,a.version FROM approval_request a JOIN employee req ON req.employee_id=a.requester_id JOIN employee apv ON apv.employee_id=a.approver_id LEFT JOIN sales_opportunity o ON a.business_type='OPPORTUNITY' AND o.opportunity_id=a.business_id

where.if: AND (LOWER(a.approval_no) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{keyword}),'%') OR LOWER(a.title) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{keyword}),'%') OR LOWER(req.employee_name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{keyword}),'%') OR LOWER(apv.employee_name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{keyword}),'%'))

mapper.select: ORDER BY a.approval_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM approval_request a JOIN employee req ON req.employee_id=a.requester_id JOIN employee apv ON apv.employee_id=a.approver_id
SELECT h.*,e.employee_name actor_name FROM approval_history h JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id=h.actor_id WHERE h.approval_id=#{approvalId} ORDER BY h.approval_history_id

SELECT DISTINCT e.employee_id,e.employee_no,e.employee_name,d.department_name FROM employee e JOIN department d ON d.department_id=e.department_id JOIN employee_role er ON er.employee_id=e.employee_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id=er.role_id WHERE e.active=TRUE AND r.active=TRUE AND r.role_code='APPROVER' ORDER BY e.employee_name

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e JOIN employee_role er ON er.employee_id=e.employee_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id=er.role_id WHERE e.employee_id=#{employeeId} AND e.active=TRUE AND r.active=TRUE AND r.role_code='APPROVER'
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_request SET approval_type=#{approvalType},business_id=#{businessId},approver_id=#{approverId},title=#{title},request_payload=#{requestPayload},updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE approval_id=#{approvalId} AND requester_id=#{actorId} AND status='DRAFT' AND version=#{version}

UPDATE approval_request SET status=#{targetStatus},requested_at=CASE WHEN #{targetStatus}='REQUESTED' THEN #{now} ELSE requested_at END,canceled_at=CASE WHEN #{targetStatus}='CANCELED' THEN #{now} ELSE canceled_at END,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE approval_id=#{approvalId} AND requester_id=#{requesterId} AND status='DRAFT' AND version=#{version}

UPDATE approval_request SET status=#{targetStatus},processed_at=#{now},updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE approval_id=#{approvalId} AND approver_id=#{approverId} AND status='REQUESTED' AND version=#{version}
